description: This report identifies overlaps in adverse events based on matching LLT terms and overlapping onset/end dates.
logic: This report lists subjects with overlapping onset dates/end dates for identical AE/VAE Terms. Identical AE/VAE terms are defined as having the same LLT after encoding. Each pair of overlapping adverse events should be output on one line. Note: Continuing adverse events (with no End Date) should also be included in the report.
report_scenarios: Scenario 1 - YES: There are adverse events that have overlapping onset dates/end dates and identical LLT after encoding. Scenario 2 - NO: overlapping dates but LLT differs. Scenario 3 - NO: identical LLT but no overlapping dates.
cql: SELECT a1.`@HDR`.`Site`.`Country` AS `Country`, a1.`@HDR`.`Site`.`Number` AS `Site`, a1.`@HDR`.`Subject`.`Name` AS `Subject Number`, a1.AESEQ AS `AE/VAE 1 Seq`, a1.AETERM AS `AE/VAE 1 Verbatim`, CODEDTERM(a1.AETERM, 'LLT') AS `AE/VAE LLT`, a1.AESTDAT AS `AE/VAE 1 Onset Dt`, a1.AEENDAT AS `AE/VAE 1 End Dt`, a2.AESEQ AS `AE/VAE 2 Seq`, a2.AETERM AS `AE/VAE 2 Verbatim`, a2.AESTDAT AS `AE/VAE 2 Onset Dt`, a2.AEENDAT AS `AE/VAE 2 End Dt` FROM AE a1 JOIN AE a2 ON a1.`@HDR`.`Subject`.`ID` = a2.`@HDR`.`Subject`.`ID` AND a1.AESEQ < a2.AESEQ WHERE `@Form`.`Status` = 'submitted__v' AND CODEDTERM(a1.AETERM, 'LLT') = CODEDTERM(a2.AETERM, 'LLT') AND a1.AESTDAT <= IFNULL(a2.AEENDAT, a1.AESTDAT) AND a2.AESTDAT <= IFNULL(a1.AEENDAT, a2.AESTDAT)
notes: Self-join pattern via two aliased instances of the same repeating Form (a1, a2), joined on Subject.ID with a1.AESEQ < a2.AESEQ to avoid duplicate/reversed pairs and self-matches. IFNULL handles ongoing AEs (NULL end date) per the spec's explicit continuing-AE requirement -- treats a missing end date as still-overlapping rather than excluding the record.
